result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would greatly increase people’s capacity for empathy—the ability to genuinely understand and feel the perspectives, pain, and hopes of others.

Many of the world’s largest problems—conflict, greed, neglect, cruelty—become harder to sustain when people truly recognize the humanity in one another. More empathy wouldn’t solve everything instantly, but it would likely lead to kinder choices, fairer systems, and more cooperation across differences.
